title: Hartverdrahtet - Akronyme Analogiker | 4k Revision 2012
summary: Hartverdrahtet by Akronyme Analogiker, the winning PC 4k intro at Revision 2012. It is a realtime demo with music and fractal visuals in 4096 bytes.
why: Cited as a showcase of what fits in 4k, in discussions of code size limits and the demoscene.

quote.text: So then I'm going to post my favorite 4k [1], which even if you ignore the file size, is just a very cool use of fractals.
